notes: Added missing integration and persistence coverage for consent workflow.

change_log.note: Adds explicit core logic story for tier transitions and enforcement
Covers storage and audit requirements not previously explicit
Explicitly enforces HIPAA Safe Harbor flow in workflow

stories.title: ConsentService Core Logic Hardening
stories.description: Implement and validate core ConsentService logic for Tier 1 vs Tier 2 consent, including upgrade paths, rejection handling, and enforcement of storage permissions at decision points.

stories.title: Consent Persistence and Audit Logging
stories.description: Persist consent decisions, tier status, and timestamps to MongoDB and integrate with debug_logger to ensure auditability of consent actions and compliance tracking.

stories.title: Lead Capture and Consent Integration
stories.description: Integrate consent workflow with lead_service to ensure Tier 2 consent is required and validated before storing identifiable lead data, including duplicate detection scenarios.

stories.title: De-identification and Summarization Pipeline Enforcement
stories.description: Enforce HIPAA Safe Harbor de-identification and conversation summarization before any storage under Tier 1 consent, ensuring no identifiable data persists without Tier 2 approval.
